name: digital-marketing-agency-landing-page
description: Professional landing page for a digital marketing agency showcasing services, case studies, and client testimonials

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js && npm run build:html && npm run build:assets
scripts.build:assets: shx mkdir -p dist/images dist/assets && shx cp -r images/* dist/images/ && shx cp -r assets/* dist/assets/
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx serve dist
